summary: I wrote src/main.ts, and typecheck passes. I didn't run `vite build` or open it in a browser, so I haven't seen it render. It builds a 260×260 ground plane. It then adds three instanced meshes (8,000 trunks, 8,000 canopies, 2,000 rocks), which together make up the 8,000 trees and 2,000 rocks. A fixed-seed linear congruential generator (seed 12345) scatters them within a 75-unit radius, so the forest is the same on every load. Canopies get per-instance HSL green colours and rocks get per-instance grey colours. The scene has one shadow-casting directional light, a hemisphere light for fill, and exponential fog (density 0.0045). The orbit camera has `autoRotate: 0.12`, so it circles slowly with the whole forest in view. `window.__EVAL_READY__` is set after `app.ready()`. I used the engine's default render loop and didn't add my own `requestAnimationFrame`.
